text: {"lessons":["My account has drifted down despite repeated trading; I’ll judge decisions by their contribution to long-run returns, not by activity or short-term price moves.","I often bought after prices had risen and later sold at losses; I’ll define an entry rationale and position size before buying, and avoid chasing momentum without evidence.","Repeatedly changing positions after losses risks locking in poor timing; I’ll reassess each holding against its thesis and risk limits rather than sell solely because it fell or hold solely to avoid admitting a loss."]}
